title: slovakian cheese bisque
description: A thick, cheesy, sour soup originating from Slovakia. Made with a variety of cheeses and spices, this dish is perfect for a cold winter day or when you're feeling under the weather.

ingredients.name: score-fat
ingredients.notes: unsalted and cold, cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the score-fat over medium heat.
Add the chopped piccalilli and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the cold sour cream and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and heated through.
Add the crumbled ricotta cheese and cook, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth.
Add the grated gruyere cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the unsalted flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, or until the mixture is lightly browned.
Gradually add the cold whole milk, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened.
Season with black pepper and nutmeg to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional gruyere cheese if desired.
